title: 第6章 来自社恐女孩的关注
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林北又向酒馆老板点了一杯果汁，端着走向悠悠那桌。

他先将餐盘放到悠悠对面的位置上，再把果汁轻轻推到她面前。

尽管林北自认为脸皮已经足够厚了，可全程被一双泛着红光的眼睛直勾勾地盯着，多少还是有些不自在。

“抱歉，没别的位置了，拼个桌行吗？这杯请你。”

悠悠见他主动搭话，顿时心头一喜，一句“当然可以，十分愿意”几乎就要脱口而出。

可话到嘴边：“如果你……非要和我坐一桌的话，也不是不行……”

其实后面还有半句：只要你愿意和我做朋友，想坐多久都可以。

但她无论如何也说不出口了。

气氛就这么僵住了。

林北在沉默中吃完了一餐饭。

被盯着咀嚼，被盯着吞咽，每一口都如坐针毡。

这大概是他这辈子最难下咽的一顿饭。

直到他起身离开公会，那种刑满释放般的解脱感才终于涌了上来。

“明天……还是去接任务吧。一个人也没什么不好的。”

在河边找了家普通旅馆，林北刚准备睡下，就听见不远处的马棚方向传来一阵吵闹。

“我可是现代人啊！这种睡马厩的日子谁受得了？我期待的冒险者生活，是那种大赚一笔然后每天吃喝玩乐啊！”

“你冲我抱怨有什么用，那个厄里斯教徒大叔给的钱只剩一千了，我们住不起旅馆。”

林北默默把被子拉过头顶，沉沉地睡了过去。

另一家豪华旅馆内。

悠悠和惠惠面对面坐在床上，互相分享着今天在阿克塞尔的经历。

惠惠虽然和人组队出了任务，但只一天就被人给劝退了。

至于悠悠……

“上午的时候，有个醉醺醺的怪大叔，非说和自己是一样的年纪，但怎么看都三十多了，他倒是想跟我组队……”

“哎？你拒绝他了吧？你绝对拒绝他了对吧？”

“拒绝是拒绝了……但他又是陪我聊天，又是请我吃午饭，感觉人还挺好的。他还说明天也会来陪我。”

“明天他要是再来，你绝对不要再理他了！还有你那个招募告示也得重写，这次认真点！另外，不要把告示贴在别人的告示上啊，很没礼貌的！”

“说起这个……今天晚上，贴那张告示的人也跟我一起吃饭了，还请我喝了一杯果汁。”

“哎？你说的是上午那个黑发小哥吗？虽然看着有点凶，但从他写的招募告示来看，应该挺靠谱的吧。就是在这种地方招募船员，多少有点莫名其妙。”

Page (1/3)

Lin Bei ordered another glass of juice from the tavern owner and walked to Youyou's table.

He first placed the dinner plate opposite Youyou, and then gently pushed the juice in front of her.

Although Lin Bei thought he was thick-skinned, he was still a little uncomfortable being stared at by a pair of glowing red eyes the whole time.

"Sorry, there's no other place. Can we share a table? This drink is for you."

Seeing him taking the initiative to talk to you, Youyou felt happy and almost blurted out "Of course, I'm very willing".

But the words came to his lips: "If you... insist on sitting at the same table with me, it's not impossible..."

In fact, there is another sentence at the end: As long as you are willing to be friends with me, you can sit here as long as you want.

But she couldn't say it anyway.

The atmosphere was so tense.

Lin Bei finished the meal in silence.

Being watched while chewing and swallowing made every bite feel like sitting on pins and needles.

This was probably the hardest meal to swallow in his life.

It wasn't until he stood up and left the guild that the feeling of relief, like being released from prison, finally came over him.

"Tomorrow... let's go get the mission. There's nothing wrong with being alone."

After finding an ordinary hotel by the river, Lin Bei was just about to sleep when he heard a noise coming from the direction of the stable not far away.

"I'm a modern person! Who can stand this kind of life of sleeping in a stable? The life of an adventurer I look forward to is one where I make a lot of money and eat, drink and have fun every day!"

"What's the use of complaining to me? The Erisian uncle only has one thousand dollars left. We can't afford to stay in a hotel."

Lin Bei silently pulled the quilt over his head and fell into a deep sleep.

Inside another luxury hotel.

Yoyo and Megumin sat face to face on the bed, sharing today's experience in Axel with each other.

Although Megumin teamed up with someone to go on a mission, she was persuaded to quit after only one day.

As for Yoyo...

"In the morning, there was a drunk and strange uncle. He was not the same age as me, but he looked like he was in his thirties. He wanted to team up with me..."

"Huh? You rejected him, right? You definitely rejected him, right?"

"Rejection means rejection...but he chatted with me and invited me to lunch. I felt that he was quite nice. He also said that he would come to accompany me tomorrow."

"If he comes again tomorrow, you must ignore him! You also need to rewrite your recruitment notice. Be careful this time! Also, don't post the notice on other people's notices. It's very rude!"

"Speaking of which... Tonight, the person who posted that notice also had dinner with me and bought me a glass of juice."

"Hey? Are you talking about the black-haired guy from this morning? Although he looks a bit fierce, judging from the recruitment notice he wrote, it should be quite reliable. It's a bit baffling to recruit crew members in a place like this."
